raw_text: South China Morning Post — China's state broadcaster CCTV aired footage on Monday showing PLA troops patrolling near the Doklam plateau, a strategically sensitive area at the India-Bhutan-China tri-junction. The broadcast triggered alarm in Indian media, with several outlets reporting it as evidence of fresh Chinese assertiveness. However, open-source investigators have raised questions about the footage's authenticity, noting that visual markers match material from the 73-day standoff in 2017. Beijing has not directly addressed the dating controversy. A PLA spokesperson reiterated that Chinese forces conduct lawful patrols within sovereign territory.
